EcoFlow is dominating our Tuesday Green Deals edition this week, as the brand is offering an early-bird $50 “lock in” deposit for its latest TITAN Series Whole-Home Backup System that will be officially launched in November. Right behind that is the latest 48-hour flash sale lineup , with options like the DELTA Pro Power Station bundle with a 400W solar panel down at $2,279, and more from $689. We also spotted Heybike offering its Mars 3.0 Folding Full Suspension e-bike at a new $1,099 low , a bunch of Anker eufy Solar Wall Light Cam S4 deals starting from $200 , a 40V 12-inch Greenworks Cordless Snow Shovel kit at a new $240 low , and more. You’ll also find the hangover deals from yesterday at the bottom of the page, like the Segway’s GT3 superscooter at its lowest price, the exclusive Anker SOLIX 6,144Wh expanded F3000 bundle deal, and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
A $50 early-bird deposit on EcoFlow’s new TITAN series whole-home backup systems saves you up to $2,999 upon launch
Homeowners have been seeing utility bills trending upwards lately, while grid failures can still happen when you least expect it, but EcoFlow is stepping into the fray with the early-bird launch of its latest TITAN Series Whole-Home Backup Ecosystem that features three varying units: the TITAN 5000 Classic, TITAN 5000, and TITAN 5000 Plus. What’s more, you can currently lock in one of three bundle deals now with a $50 payment , saving you up to $2,999 in November when it officially releases (and when you’ll pay the remaining balance). Head below to learn all about this new series and get a rundown on these early-bird offers.
You can get a rundown on what to expect from this new whole-home backup system here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
EcoFlow offers 48-hour deals, like the 3,600Wh DELTA Pro power station + 400W solar panel at $2,279, more from $689
As part of the EcoFlow Prime Encore Sale , the brand has launched a 48-hour flash sale with up to 38% discounts on three power station bundles and a solo expansion battery for the DELTA 3 series. Among the bundles, you can find the tried-and-true 3,600Wh DELTA Pro Portable Power Station with a 400W solar panel down at $2,279.05 shipped , after using the code EFPDFAFF at checkout, beating Amazon’s pricing by $120 , though you do get a FREE 160W panel there, too. While it carries a $3,098 MSRP directly, it has only been seen going as high as $2,999 this fall, with the discount initially only taking things down to $2,299, but the extra savings code lets it go further by another $20. While we have seen it go lower in the past – especially for two days during last week’s Prime Day event – you’re still looking at a solid total $720 markdown here for the second-best price we have tracked in the last few months. Head below to check out the full lineup of 2-day flash deals, or browse the full sale on the landing page here – just don’t forget to use the above code.
***Note: Due to the nature of the brand’s flash sale, some units have additional savings taken off in your cart (the prices listed below), which cannot stack with the extra 5% off savings code EFPDFAFF . In some cases (like with the DELTA Pro bundle) that code provides more savings than the flash sale, but others may not.
EcoFlow’s latest 48-hour flash sale units:
DELTA 3 Classic (1,024Wh) with 220W solar panel: $689 (Reg. $899) | $10 more at Amazon
DELTA 3 Max Plus expansion battery (2,048Wh): $829 (Reg. $1,329) | $30 more at Amazon
DELTA Pro (3,600Wh) with 400W solar panel: $2,299 (Reg. $3,098) | $100 more at Amazon
DELTA Pro Ultra (6,144Wh) with trolley and FREE monitor: $4,099 (Reg. $6,099) | $100 more at Amazon without bundled gear
Heybike’s Mars 3.0 folding full suspension e-bike with NFC startup security hits new $1,099 low, more
As part of its current Fall Riding Sale , Heybike is offering the best price to date on its Mars 3.0 Folding Full Suspension Fat Tire e-bike down at $1,099 shipped . Originally carrying a $1,799 MSRP, the brand has made a permanent price cut down to a $1,199 MSRP. Previously, we saw discounts land the price anywhere from $1,499 to $1,199, but the deal here gives you $100 savings off the new going rate for a new all-time low price. You can shop the rest of the sale on the main page here , and if you choose to go with the ALPHA Mid-Drive All-Terrain e-bike , be sure to use our exclusive code 9TO5TOYS200 at checkout to score it at its best rate.
You can learn more about the Heybike Mars 3.0’s features here .
Save up to $312 on Anker’s latest solar Wall Light Cam S4 or multi-packs with HomeBase 3 starting from $200
Through its official Amazon storefront, you can currently find Anker’s latest eufy Solar Security Wall Light Cam S4 down at $199.99 shipped , matching the price direct from the brands website . This new model just hit the market back in August with a $250 full price tag, which we’ve seen previously discounted to $200 and then a one-time dip to a $190 low during last week’s Prime Day event. You’re getting the next-best price here with the $50 savings – just $10 above that low. What’s more, Amazon is offering greater bundle deals for the Wall Light Cam S4 2-pack with HomeBase 3 down at $496.97 shipped (beating the direct website by $53 ), or the 4-pack bundle with HomeBase 3 down at $887.95 shipped (beating the direct website by $62 ).
You can learn all about this Wall Light Cam S4’s features here .
Prep for winter clearing with Greenworks’ 40V 12-inch cordless snow shovel kit at a new $240 low ($60 off)
Over at Amazon you can find the Greenworks 40V 12-inch Cordless Electric Snow Shovel with 4.0Ah battery down at $239.99 shipped . Down from a $300 MSRP directly, this newer unit has largely been out of stock for most of 2026, having been restocked at the start of September with a higher $330 rate, which has only gone as low as $300 in the time since. With the deal here, you’re getting a $60 markdown off the MSRP ($90 off the higher restocked rate), landing it at the best price we have tracked in its history since hitting the market in late August 2025.
You can learn about this newer snow shovel’s features here .
